summary.name: Faceless Reels
summary.one_liner: A web-based AI generator that turns a topic into a voiced, captioned, faceless short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
use_cases: Make faceless TikTok videos from a topic
Produce narrated explainer or facts videos
Generate storytelling or history clips with voiceover
Batch-test video topics and hooks for a short-video channel
summary.what_it_does: Faceless Reels takes a chosen workflow template and a topic (or user-provided source material) and generates a hook, script, AI voiceover, visuals, captions, background music, and edit as a vertical video. Users review the result and download the finished file to publish on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels, or other platforms. Templates cover formats such as Brainrot MOV, storytelling, doodle explainers, product clips, and facts. The page states that new accounts receive 100 free signup credits with no card required, and that monthly, yearly, and extra credit options are available. Direct auto-publishing is only available for TikTok or Instagram accounts where social publishing is configured.
notable: Generates hook, script, voiceover, visuals, captions, music, and edit from one topic prompt
Reusable workflow templates such as Brainrot MOV, storytelling, and doodle explainers
100 free credits on signup with no card required
Optional direct publishing to connected TikTok or Instagram accounts
caveats: Paid monthly or yearly plans and extra credit packages are needed beyond the free signup credits
Web-based only; no native iOS or Android app
The page makes no guarantee of views, monetization eligibility, or income, and platform policies apply to AI-generated content
